# Work Item Plan

## Work Item WI-001: 后端关卡 API 与静态服务

### Identity
- schema_version: 1
- logical_work_item_id: WI-001
- title: 后端关卡 API 与静态服务
- kind: backend

### Goal
- summary: WHEN 服务启动并接收 HTTP 请求 THE SYSTEM SHALL 使用 Node 内置模块提供可配置的关卡 API、静态托管和可测试的服务生命周期。

### Non Goals
- non_goals: 不修改 `web/**`、`tests/frontend/**`、`tests/integration/**`，不实现关卡玩法、数据库、认证或新增依赖。

### Dependencies
- depends_on: []

### Inputs

### Outputs
- contract_id: CT-001
- capabilities: GET /api/levels validates EXE-006 field constraints
- capabilities: GET /api/levels returns 200 with top-level array of five level records
- capabilities: GET /api/levels returns 500 with LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE JSON for invalid data
- capabilities: unknown API path returns 404 JSON error
- capabilities: unsupported API method returns 405 JSON error

- contract_id: CT-002
- capabilities: GET / serves page entry from configurable staticRoot
- capabilities: static paths resolve safely within configurable staticRoot
- capabilities: missing static resource returns 404 text response

- contract_id: CT-003
- capabilities: createServer(options) accepts dataPath and staticRoot
- capabilities: start({ port }) resolves { origin, port, stop }
- capabilities: port 0 selects an available temporary port

### Tasks
- task_id: TASK-001
- statement: WHEN 后端服务模块被实现 THE SYSTEM SHALL 仅使用 Node 内置模块并导出 `createServer(options)`、`start({ port })` 与可等待的 `stop()`。
- requirement_refs: REQ-004
- requirement_refs: NFR-001
- done_when_refs: AC-001

- task_id: TASK-002
- statement: WHEN `GET /api/levels` 收到请求 THE SYSTEM SHALL 从可配置 JSON 路径读取并校验恰好五条记录后返回符合 EXE-006 的顶层数组。
- requirement_refs: REQ-002
- requirement_refs: REQ-003
- done_when_refs: AC-001

- task_id: TASK-003
- statement: WHEN 关卡数据缺失、不可读、无法解析或校验失败 THE SYSTEM SHALL 返回状态 500 与 `LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE` 的 JSON 错误结构。
- requirement_refs: REQ-002
- requirement_refs: REQ-003
- done_when_refs: AC-001

- task_id: TASK-004
- statement: WHEN API 路径不存在或方法不受支持 THE SYSTEM SHALL 分别返回 JSON 结构的 404 或 405 响应。
- requirement_refs: REQ-002
- done_when_refs: AC-001

- task_id: TASK-005
- statement: WHEN 静态资源被请求 THE SYSTEM SHALL 使用 `node:path` 规范化并限制在可配置 `staticRoot` 内，缺失资源返回 404 文本响应。
- requirement_refs: REQ-004
- done_when_refs: AC-001

- task_id: TASK-006
- statement: WHEN 后端验证执行 THE SYSTEM SHALL 通过自有夹具在 `tests/backend/**` 完成成功、数据错误、API 错误、生命周期和静态安全断言且不读取 `web/**`。
- requirement_refs: NFR-001
- done_when_refs: AC-001

### Write Policy
- exclusive_scopes: server/**
- exclusive_scopes: data/levels.json
- exclusive_scopes: tests/backend/**
- forbidden_scopes: web/**
- forbidden_scopes: tests/frontend/**
- forbidden_scopes: tests/integration/**

### Acceptance Criteria
- criterion_id: AC-001
- statement: WHEN `node --test tests/backend/` 运行 THE SYSTEM SHALL 以非零数量的通过测试证明服务生命周期、五项合法关卡 API、数据与路由错误语义以及独立夹具静态托管边界。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution

### Verification
- check_id: CHECK-001
- command: node --test tests/backend/
- manual_instruction: null
- required: true
- non_zero_test_execution_required: true

### Handoff Schema
- required_fields: backend_contract_test_report
- provided_contract_refs: CT-001
- provided_contract_refs: CT-002
- provided_contract_refs: CT-003
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-001

### Blockers

### Traceability

- source_id: design_spec_0001

## Work Item WI-002: 关卡选择页与前端逻辑

### Identity
- schema_version: 1
- logical_work_item_id: WI-002
- title: 关卡选择页与前端逻辑
- kind: frontend

### Goal
- summary: WHEN 玩家打开关卡选择页 THE SYSTEM SHALL 通过 `GET /api/levels` 渲染名称、难度和锁定态，并在请求或响应异常时保留页面框架与可读错误提示。

### Non Goals
- non_goals: 不修改 `server/**`、`data/levels.json`、`tests/backend/**`、`tests/integration/**`，不实现关卡玩法或引入浏览器自动化与前端依赖。

### Dependencies
- depends_on: WI-001

### Inputs
- contract_id: CT-001
- provider_logical_work_item_id: WI-001
- required_capabilities: GET /api/levels validates EXE-006 field constraints
- required_capabilities: GET /api/levels returns 200 with top-level array of five level records
- required_capabilities: GET /api/levels returns 500 with LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE JSON for invalid data
- compatibility_policy: require_all

### Outputs
- contract_id: CT-004
- capabilities: script exports initLevelSelect({ document, fetchImpl })
- capabilities: page entry path is web/index.html
- capabilities: HTML contains id=loading
- capabilities: HTML contains id=level-list
- capabilities: HTML contains id=error-message
- capabilities: HTML contains relative API path /api/levels
- capabilities: page script path is web/level-select.js
- capabilities: DOM renderer displays name and difficulty
- capabilities: DOM renderer disables unlocked=false levels
- capabilities: DOM renderer shows readable error without blank page

### Tasks
- task_id: TASK-007
- statement: WHEN 页面骨架被实现 THE SYSTEM SHALL 在 `web/index.html` 提供 `loading`、`level-list`、`error-message` 三个容器、相对 API 路径引用和 `web/level-select.js` 脚本引入。
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- done_when_refs: AC-002

- task_id: TASK-008
- statement: WHEN 页面脚本被实现 THE SYSTEM SHALL 暴露可注入 `document` 与 `fetchImpl` 的 `initLevelSelect({ document, fetchImpl })` 并在页面加载时调用。
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- requirement_refs: NFR-001
- done_when_refs: AC-002

- task_id: TASK-009
- statement: WHEN API 返回合法五项数组 THE SYSTEM SHALL 先结束加载状态，再用安全文本节点渲染每项名称、难度，并将 `unlocked=false` 的关卡设为不可选择。
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- done_when_refs: AC-002

- task_id: TASK-010
- statement: WHEN fetch 失败、HTTP 状态非成功或响应结构不符合 EXE-006 THE SYSTEM SHALL 显示可读错误提示并保留基本页面框架。
- requirement_refs: REQ-006
- done_when_refs: AC-002

- task_id: TASK-011
- statement: WHEN 前端验证执行 THE SYSTEM SHALL 通过 Node 内置测试与 DOM 替身验证成功渲染、锁定态和错误分支且不启动浏览器。
- requirement_refs: NFR-001
- done_when_refs: AC-002

### Write Policy
- exclusive_scopes: web/**
- exclusive_scopes: tests/frontend/**
- forbidden_scopes: server/**
- forbidden_scopes: data/levels.json
- forbidden_scopes: tests/backend/**
- forbidden_scopes: tests/integration/**

### Acceptance Criteria
- criterion_id: AC-002
- statement: WHEN `node --test tests/frontend/` 运行 THE SYSTEM SHALL 以非零数量的通过测试证明页面结构契约、可注入渲染接口、合法响应渲染、锁定态以及失败时不白屏的可读错误分支。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution

### Verification
- check_id: CHECK-002
- command: node --test tests/frontend/
- manual_instruction: null
- required: true
- non_zero_test_execution_required: true

### Handoff Schema
- required_fields: frontend_contract_test_report
- provided_contract_refs: CT-004
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-002

### Blockers
